description: This file defines the interface for a unit test Key-Value Pair (KVP) framework in C, including enums for status codes, function declarations for creating/destroying instances, opening files or memory payloads, retrieving various data types by key, and serializing the KVP data.

methods.name: ut_kvp_createInstance
methods.description: Creates a new KVP instance and returns its handle or NULL on failure.

methods.name: ut_kvp_destroyInstance
methods.description: Destroys a KVP instance and releases resources.

methods.name: ut_kvp_open
methods.description: Opens and parses a KVP file into a KVP instance.

methods.name: ut_kvp_openMemory
methods.description: Parses a caller-owned memory buffer containing KVP data into an instance.

methods.name: ut_kvp_close
methods.description: Closes a KVP instance and frees its resources.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getBoolField
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean value for a given key.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getUInt8Field
methods.description: Retrieves a uint8_t value for a given key.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getUInt16Field
methods.description: Retrieves a uint16_t value for a given key.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getUInt32Field
methods.description: Retrieves a uint32_t value for a given key.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getUInt64Field
methods.description: Retrieves a uint64_t value for a given key.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getStringField
methods.description: Retrieves a string value for a given key, copying it into a caller-provided buffer.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getFloatField
methods.description: Retrieves a float value for a given key.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getDoubleField
methods.description: Retrieves a double value for a given key.

methods.name: ut_kvp_fieldPresent
methods.description: Checks if a key is present in the KVP profile.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getData
methods.description: Returns a serialized string of the KVP data.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getListCount
methods.description: Returns the count of list elements associated with a key.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getDataBytes
methods.description: Retrieves data bytes associated with a key, with the caller responsible for freeing the returned memory.

ctags.name: UT_KVP_STATUS_FILE_OPEN_ERROR
ctags.pattern: /^    UT_KVP_STATUS_FILE_OPEN_ERROR,   \/**!< Failed to open the file. *\/$/

ctags.name: UT_KVP_STATUS_KEY_NOT_FOUND
ctags.pattern: /^    UT_KVP_STATUS_KEY_NOT_FOUND,     \/**!< Key not found in the KVP instance. *\/$/

ctags.name: UT_KVP_STATUS_MAX
ctags.pattern: /^    UT_KVP_STATUS_MAX                \/**!< Out of range marker (not a valid status). *\/$/
